meta.description: Groups proteins from peptide identifications, reports indistinguishable protein groups with a leading protein, and controls protein or protein-group false discovery rate using picked methods.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: Synthetic truth data is labelled as synthetic; no DOI, clinical result, or numeric result was fabricated.

practice_boundaries.detail: The patient/isoform adversarial case is refused and routed to validated PRM/MRM rather than discovery-group interpretation.

methodological_ground.detail: Runs preserve the distinction between PSM and protein FDR, reject HYE as an entrapment control, and retain group rather than flat-list reporting.

code_usability.detail: All copied shipped Python scripts compiled and executed; parsed output assertions passed. The Philosopher script's nonzero exit is its designed empty-output guard, not an unhandled failure.

functional_suitability.note: Covers OpenMS, EPIFANY, Percolator, Philosopher, MaxQuant semantics, group reporting, scope boundaries, and picked FDR.

reliability.note: Wrong-prefix and silent-empty Philosopher failure modes have explicit guards; a compatible positive Philosopher pepXML path remains unverified locally.

performance_context.note: Method selection stays in SKILL.md while four focused references and executable scripts provide progressive detail.

agent_usability.note: Decision tree, input/output contracts, tool-version checks, and common-error table make the routes operationally clear.

human_usability.note: Natural trigger language, plain vocabulary, and explicit out-of-scope routes are present.

security.note: No credentials, destructive operations, or raw command interpolation are present; file paths are assumed to be analyst-supplied trusted inputs.

maintainability.note: The concise dispatcher, single-purpose reference files, and runnable scripts have clear responsibilities and were independently replayed from copies.

agent_specific.note: Trigger is precise, progressive disclosure is strong, outputs are reproducible, and clinical/isoform stop conditions are explicit; the external CLI compatibility branch needs a positive fixture.

key_strengths: All runnable shipped Python scripts were replayed from audit copies and their output files were parsed rather than trusted by exit status.
The Percolator CLI route produced 458 checked 1%-FDR representatives on real Comet artifacts.
The Philosopher empty-result failure is visibly guarded, preventing a false 0% FDR success report.
Group reporting, entrapment preconditions, and patient/isoform boundaries were upheld across regression and new cases.

recommendations.title: Verify a positive Philosopher/ProteinProphet chain
recommendations.problem: Philosopher 5.1.0 processed 6,135 search results but modelled zero PeptideProphet PSMs for both available pepXML forms, so a nonempty ProteinProphet/filter success path could not be demonstrated locally.
recommendations.root_cause: The local Philosopher/TPP-derived pepXML ingestion path is incompatible with the available Comet and OpenMS-reserialised fixtures; this is not a silent Skill failure because the guard stops it.
recommendations.fix: Before a workflow depends on this optional route, run the documented commands against a compatible pepXML fixture or functioning Philosopher/TPP environment and assert nonempty peptideprophet_result, prot.xml, and protein.tsv. Do not retry the prohibited standalone TPP installer.
